techniques.name: Autodestruction
techniques.description: Let's press the big red button with the danger signs! The Digital attacker inflicts massive damage and self-destructs in the process.
techniques.effectText: Autodestruction's damage formula is close, but not exactly equal to, the combination of the damage it would deal based on ATK and the damage it would deal based on DEF. The exact formula is intended to be:

wiki.infobox:
{{Technique Infobox
| image = Autodestruction.mp4
| description = Let's press the big red button with the danger signs! The {{type|digital|18|0}} Digital attacker inflicts massive damage and self-destructs in the process.
| type = Digital
| class = Physical
| damage = 130
| stamina = 0
| hold = 3
| priority = 4
| targeting = others
}}
wiki.effect:
{{PAGENAME}}'s damage formula is close, but not exactly equal to, the combination of the damage it would deal based on {{stat|atk|25|1}} and the damage it would deal based on {{stat|def|25|1}}. The exact formula is intended to be:

<math>RegularDamage = \bigl(\tfrac{Level}{200} \times 130 \times \tfrac{ATK}{DDEF} \bigr) \times Modifier</math>

<math>BonusDamage = \bigl(\tfrac{Level}{200} \times 40 \times \tfrac{ADEF}{DDEF} \bigr) \times Modifier</math>

<math>FinalDamage = 7 + RegularDamage + BonusDamage</math>

<small>
* ADEF refers to the current DEF value of the attacker. (When the technique is used)
* DDEF refers to the current DEF value of the defender. (When the technique is used)
</small>

This damage should always be rounded up.

wiki.effect:
{{PAGENAME}} deals [[Techniques#Damage|damage]] to a [[Techniques#Targeting|single other target]] with its damage varying based on the user's current {{stat|sta|25|1}}.

The following formula applies: 
<math>Damage = \bigl(7 + \tfrac{Level}{200} \times 90 \times (\tfrac{ATK}{DEF} + \tfrac{CSTA}{DEF} \bigr) \times Modifier</math>

* CSTA refers to the user's current {{stat|sta|25|2}} '''after''' the technique STA cost have been applied. (Before damage calculation)
* The damage from {{stat|sta|25|2}} only has [[Techniques#Damage|STAB]] and [[Temtem types|Type]] effectiveness modifiers applied. It is considered a type of "bonus damage", and so does not get modified from any [[Items]] or [[Traits]].

<math>RegularDamage = \bigl(\tfrac{Level}{200} \times 65 \times \tfrac{SPATK}{SPDEF} \bigr) \times Modifier</math><ref name="YaW" />

<math>BonusDamage = \bigl(\tfrac{Level}{200} \times 56 \times \tfrac{SPD}{SPDEF} \bigr) \times Modifier</math>

<math>FinalDamage = 7 + RegularDamage + BonusDamage</math>

This damage should always be rounded up.

traits.name: Tri-Phytologist
traits.description: When attacking with a physical technique, the target gets exhausted for 2 turns if it's a rival or invigorated for 2 turns if it's an ally or itself.
traits.effect: When the holder attacks a target with a Physical Technique, Tri-Phytologist inflicts the target with the Exhausted Status Condition for 2 turns if the target is a rival or the Invigorated Status Condition for 2 turns if the target is the holder itself or its ally.

wiki.effect: When the holder attacks a [[Techniques#Targeting|target]] with a {{class|physical|25|1}} [[Techniques|Technique]], {{PAGENAME}} inflicts the [[Techniques#Targeting|target]] with the {{condition|exhausted|25|1}} [[Status Conditions|Status Condition]] for 2 turns if the target is a rival or the {{condition|vigor|25|1}} [[Status Conditions|Status Condition]] for 2 turns if the target is the holder itself or its ally.

traits.name: Unnoticed
traits.description: Gets SPD after not receiving any rival attacks during the turn.
traits.effect: Unnoticed gifts the holder with SPD so long as the holder does not take any damage from Techniques from the rival team while being present on the battlefield.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} gifts the holder with {{statchange|+1|spd|14|1}} so long as the holder does not take any [[Techniques#Damage|damage]] from [[Techniques]] from the rival team while being present on the battlefield.

traits.name: Vigorous
traits.description: Damage done when overexerting is increased by 50%.
traits.effect: Vigorous increases the damage of the holder's Techniques by 50% when the holder Overexerts.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} increases the damage of the holder's [[Techniques]] by 50% when the holder [[Combat#Stamina|Overexerts]].

traits.name: Viral Combustion
traits.description: When getting a poison status condition, the attacker gets burned for 4 turns.
traits.effect: Viral Combustion inflicts the Burned Condition for 4 turns onto any attacker that inflicts the Poisoned Condition onto the holder.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} inflicts the {{condition|burn|25|1}} Condition for 4 turns onto any attacker that inflicts the {{condition|poison|25|1}} Condition onto the holder.

traits.name: Voltaic Charge
traits.description: The caster heals 20% of the damage it has done with any offensive technique.
traits.effect: Voltaic Charge restores 20% of the damage the holder inflicts to the target as HP.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} restores 20% of the damage the holder inflicts to the [[Techniques#Targeting|target]] as {{stat|hp|25|2}}.

traits.name: Voodoo
traits.description: When the holder applies a negative Status Condition or Stage change to a rival, the effects of those are applied to the rival’s partner too.
traits.effect: When the holder of Voodoo applies a negative Status Condition or Stage change to a rival, the effects of those are applied to the rival’s partner too.

wiki.effect: When the holder of {{PAGENAME}} applies a [[Status_Conditions#Negative_Status_Conditions|negative Status Condition]] or Stage change to a rival, the effects of those are applied to the rival’s partner too.

traits.name: Warm Gift
traits.description: When a rival exits the battlefield, they get burned for 3 turns.
traits.effect: Warm Gift inflicts the Burned Condition for 3 turns onto any rival that exits the battlefield.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} inflicts the {{condition|burn|25|1}} Condition for 3 turns onto any rival that exits the battlefield.

traits.name: Warm-Blooded
traits.description: Prevents the Cold and Frozen status condition.
traits.effect: Warm-Blooded protects the holder from being inflicted with the Cold and Frozen Conditions.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} protects the holder from being inflicted with the {{condition|cold|25|1}} and {{condition|frozen|25|1}} Conditions.

traits.name: Water Affinity
traits.description: Water techniques get type damage boost.
traits.effect: Water Affinity increases the damage of the holder's Water Techniques by 50%, as if they had STAB. This boost stacks with actual STAB if the holder is part Water.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} increases the damage of the holder's {{type|water|25|1}} [[Techniques]] by 50%, as if they had [[Techniques#Damage|STAB]]. This boost stacks with actual STAB if the holder is part {{type|water|25|3}}.

traits.name: Water Custodian
traits.description: Water techniques targeting the ally will target the Temtem instead and it will get SPATK .
traits.effect: Water Custodian causes all incoming Water Techniques targeting the holder's ally to hit the holder instead and if the technique was successfully redirected the user will get SPATK .

wiki.effect:
{{PAGENAME}} causes all incoming {{type|water|25|1}} [[Techniques]] targeting the holder's ally to hit the holder instead and if the technique was successfully redirected the user will get {{statchange|+2|spatk|13|1}}. 

The {{statchange|+2|spatk|13|1}} increase of {{PAGENAME}} will also activate if the holder and its ally get hit by a {{type|water|25|1}} [[Techniques|Technique]] at the same time (For example by [[Tsunami]]) or if only the holder gets hit by a {{type|water|25|1}} [[Techniques|Technique]].

traits.name: Water Synthesizer
traits.description: When attacked with a Water technique, restores HP instead of receiving damage.
traits.effect: Water Synthesizer protects the holder from taking damage from Water Techniques and restores their HP equal to the amount of damage they would've taken.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} protects the holder from taking [[Techniques#Damage|damage]] from {{type|water|25|1}} [[Techniques]] and restores their {{stat|hp|25|2}} equal to the amount of damage they would've taken.

traits.name: Wax Bath
traits.description: Wax Bath decreases the damage the holder takes from Fire Techniques by 25% and invalidates the effects of the Burn Status Condition.
traits.effect: Wax Bath decreases the damage the holder takes from Fire Techniques by 25% and protects them from being inflicted with the Burned Condition.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} decreases the damage the holder takes from Fire Techniques by 25% and protects them from being inflicted with the {{condition|burn|25|1}} [[Status Conditions|Condition]].

traits.name: Welcomer
traits.description: Once per battle, when the holder spends 1 turn the battlefield, the ally gets evading for 1 turn.
traits.effect: Once per battle, Welcomer gifts the holder's ally with the Evading Condition for 1 turn when the holder has spent 1 turn on the battlefield.

wiki.effect: When an ally enters the battlefield, the ally restores 10% of its max HP.

traits.name: Withdrawal
traits.description: When resting, restores 20% of max HP and removes asleep and poisoned status conditions.
traits.effect: Withdrawal restores 20% of the holder's maximum HP and cures them of the Asleep and Poisoned Conditions whenever they Rest.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} restores 20% of the holder's maximum {{stat|hp|25|2}} and cures them of the {{condition|asleep|25|1}} and {{condition|poison|25|1}} Conditions whenever they [[Combat#Stamina|Rest]].

traits.name: Wrecked Farewell
traits.description: The rival loses 10% of its max STA and gets ATK and SPATK when it knocks the holder out. In case the holder is self knocked-out, both rivals receive the effects of Wrech Farewell.
traits.effect: Wrecked Farewell causes the rival to lose 10% of their maximum STA when they knocked out the holder. If the holder knocks themself out, the effect is applied to all rivals.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} causes the rival to lose 10% of their maximum {{stat|sta|25|2}}, {{stat|atk|25|1}} -2 stages and {{stat|spatk|25|1}} -2 when they [[Combat#Health| knocked out]] the holder. If the holder knocks themself out, the effects are applied to all rivals.

traits.name: Zen
traits.description: When getting an asleep status condition, gets DEF and SPDEF .
traits.effect: Zen gifts the holder with DEF and SPDEF upon being inflicted with the Asleep Condition.

wiki.effect: {{PAGENAME}} gifts the holder with {{statchange|+2|def|13|1}} and {{statchange|+2|spdef|13|1}} upon being inflicted with the {{condition|asleep|25|1}} [[Status Conditions|Condition]].

conditions.name: Asleep
conditions.description: Asleep Temtem cannot attack. If they are damaged, including damage from other conditions like Burned or Poisoned, they will wake up and the Asleep condition is removed. Upon waking, the Temtem will gain the Alerted condition until the end of the next turn. Mental type Temtem are immune against the Asleep condition.

conditions.name: Burned
conditions.description: Burned Temtem lose 1/16 of their health every turn and it reduces both the ATK and SPATK stats by 30%. Temtem of the Fire type are immune against this condition. The Burned condition erases the Cold and Frozen conditions when applied to a Temtem, and vice versa these conditions can remove the Burned condition.

conditions.name: Cold
conditions.description: While the Cold status condition does not have a direct impact, it serves to set up the Frozen status condtions listed below. Cold erases the Burned Condition from a Temtem, while Burned erases both the Cold and Frozen conditions.

conditions.name: Frozen
conditions.description: If Cold is afflicted twice, the Temtem becomes Frozen. Frozen Temtem cannot attack, but they can rest normally. Like Cold, Frozen also erases the Burned Condition from a Temtem, while Burned erases both the Cold and Frozen conditions.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.description: The Stamina cost of techniques used by an Exhausted Temtem increases by 50%. Applying the Invigorated condition removes the Exhausted condition and vice versa.

conditions.name: Isolated
conditions.description: Synergies do not work with Isolated Temtem.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Poisoned Temtem lose 1/8 of their health every turn. Temtem of the Toxic type are immune against this condition.

conditions.name: Seized
conditions.description: Seized Temtem lose their equipped gear's effect.

conditions.name: Alerted
conditions.description: An Alerted Temtem cannot fall asleep. After a Temtem loses the Asleep Condition, it will gain Alerted until the end of the next turn.

conditions.name: Regenerated
conditions.description: Regenerated Temtem heal 1/10 of their health on each turn.

conditions.name: Evading
conditions.description: An Evading Temtem will not be affected by the next offensive technique used on it. Once damaged, this condition is removed.

conditions.name: Immune
conditions.description: Immune Temtem are unable to be afflicted with new status conditions.

conditions.name: Invigorated
conditions.description: The Stamina cost of techniques used by a Invigorated Temtem decreases by 50%. Applying the Exhausted condition removes the Invigorated condition and vice versa.

conditions.name: Nullified
conditions.description: Nullified Temtem have their type based resistances and weaknesses omitted. STAB (Same Type Attack Bonus) does still apply while under the effect of Nullified.

conditions.name: Doomed
conditions.description: Once the turn counter on the Doomed Temtem hits 0, the Temtem faints.
